claim_boundary: This artifact combines internal project review, pattern-assisted review, mechanically identified defects, scorer effects, and blind LLM re-review on permitted development records. It does not correct gold, replace an original score, inspect test60, establish prevalence outside the retained records, or provide independent clinical validation. Clinical-validity claims require independent clinical review.

evidence_statements.finding: The source guideline allows one phrase to carry more than one concept when contexts differ; multiplicity can therefore be a prescribed representation, not automatically duplicate gold.
evidence_statements.handling: Keep multiplicity visible and test a separate multiplicity-insensitive view.
evidence_statements.subject: annotation_convention

evidence_statements.finding: The guideline instructs annotators to retain multiple time periods and maps 'well controlled' to infrequent; these conventions can differ from a model's single consolidated state.
evidence_statements.handling: Treat convention differences separately from mechanical gold defects.
evidence_statements.subject: annotation_convention

evidence_statements.claim_strength: historical internal dev140 adjudication; not clinical validation
evidence_statements.finding: The internal review assigned 15/53 disagreements to model error, 22/53 to annotation mismatch or redundancy, and 16/53 to ambiguity or temporal convention. Exact per-letter agreement was 62.1%; the internally defensible view was 89.3%.
evidence_statements.handling: Keep state_profile primary and the internally defensible percentage as a separate historical sensitivity result.
evidence_statements.subject: ambiguity_multiplicity_and_scoring

evidence_statements.finding: The historical review classified 31/209 disagreements as model errors, 167/209 as model-defensible annotation mismatch, and 11/209 as ambiguous.
evidence_statements.handling: Retain as historical mechanism evidence only. Its 0.6617-to-0.9501 adjustment belongs to a different run and scorer and is superseded for current magnitude.
evidence_statements.subject: multiplicity_and_representation

evidence_statements.claim_strength: internal LLM blind re-review with small samples
evidence_statements.finding: A 40-case blind LLM re-review had 60.0% raw agreement and pooled unweighted kappa 0.397. The aggregate reweighted Diagnosis estimate shifted more than Seizure Frequency, so individual clinical-equivalence judgments remain soft.
evidence_statements.handling: Report the negative reproducibility result and do not treat the re-review as external validation.
evidence_statements.subject: review_reproducibility

evidence_statements.claim_strength: completed project triage on dev140; not independent clinical adjudication
evidence_statements.finding: The current 246-row review contains 173 representation decisions, 72 extraction errors, and 1 uncertain row. Review provenance is 197 pattern-assisted and 49 manual; 1 manual row remains unresolved.
evidence_statements.handling: Gold and the fixed scorer remain unchanged; pattern-assisted rows stay project hypotheses.
evidence_statements.subject: current_review_status

evidence_statements.claim_strength: reproducible dev140 arithmetic with unchanged gold and scorer
evidence_statements.handling: Treat both sensitivity views as diagnostic reinterpretations of fixed outputs, not replacement scores or corrected clinical accuracy.
evidence_statements.subject: sensitivity_scoring

evidence_statements.finding: Rules and hybrid fixes remain development candidates; the LLM-only prompt candidate was rejected after regression. No candidate was promoted.
evidence_statements.handling: Do not mix candidate score changes with sensitivity reinterpretation.
evidence_statements.subject: handling

evidence_statements.finding: Mechanical defects, annotation conventions, internal judgments, score effects, and sensitivity results are now traceable, but no source supplies independent clinical validation.
evidence_statements.handling: Require independent clinical review before making clinical-validity claims.
evidence_statements.subject: clinical_validity

limitations: The historical Diagnosis narrative reports 209 concept disagreements, while the selected generated Diagnosis family ledger contains 199 rows. All 57 letter IDs explicitly cited across the three narrative reports are mapped, but ten historical Diagnosis concept rows cannot be reconstructed from the retained files and remain aggregate-only evidence.

The 584 taxonomy entries overlap across historical family ledgers, direct defect records, and the current Diagnosis review. They are evidence records, not unique letters and not a prevalence denominator.
The blind re-review was performed by LLM sub-agents on small samples; its narrative report is retained, but it is not independent clinical review.
